title: LoupixDeck profile index
description: The list of community profiles. Generated by scripts/build_index.py from the profiles/ folder; never edit it by hand. LoupixDeck downloads this file and installs from it.

id.description: Stable id, unique across the whole repository; names the profile's folder.

author.description: GitHub user name of the author; names the parent folder.

version.description: Version of the submission, raised by the author on every change.

updatedAt.description: Time of the last commit that changed the profile's folder.

license.description: SPDX identifier of the license the profile is shared under.

platforms.description: Systems the profile is meant for (it may launch programs or bind platform-only plugins). Empty means every platform.

kind.description: Copied from the package manifest: what the package contains.

companionDevices.description: Copied from the package manifest: names of companion devices whose pages the package carries.

requiredPlugins.description: Copied from the package manifest: plugins the profile binds commands to.

commands.description: Copied from the package manifest: every command name the package references, so the app can show what the profile does before installing it.

macros.description: Copied from the package manifest: names of the macros the package carries.

formatVersion.description: Copied from the package manifest: envelope version of the .loupixprofile package.

configSchemaVersion.description: Copied from the package manifest: config schema the payload was written with.

appVersion.description: Copied from the package manifest: LoupixDeck version that exported the package.

preview.description: HTTPS URL of the preview image.

device.description: Copied from the package manifest: device the package was exported from.

sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the package; a download that does not match is refused.

size.description: Size of the package in bytes.
